## Scope
SENTINEL APEX SOC brings together source-attributed cyber threat intelligence, vulnerability analysis, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident readiness and scoped enterprise SOC assessment. Managed customer monitoring and response are not generally available without separately authorized service terms.

## Citation guidance
When citing a report, preserve its canonical URL, title, publication or update date when present, and upstream evidence links. Do not infer independent verification beyond what the page explicitly documents.
